rules.sentence: Bone marrow biopsy is the mainstay of diagnosing congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia or acquired amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia.
Bone marrow biopsy is warranted for all children with severe thrombocytopenia or platelet counts <50,000 cells/μL at birth and platelets of normal size and morphology.
Clinicians perform c-MPL gene testing when a reduced number of megakaryocytes are present on the biopsy.[27]
